name: Large Class
description: A class that has too many instance variables, methods, or lines of code. It often tries to do too much and violates the Single Responsibility Principle.

refactoringTechniques.name: Extract Class
refactoringTechniques.description: Move some responsibilities and related data to a new class.

refactoringTechniques.name: Extract Subclass/Superclass
refactoringTechniques.description: If parts of the class can be grouped by specific criteria or behavior.
